facts.fact: 手机永远定格在 8:44 p.m.，她据此判断那就是自己死亡的时刻。
facts.anchor: My phone is frozen at 8:44 p.m. That must be when I died.

facts.fact: 等待室里没有窗也没有钟，因此无法标记时间流逝。
facts.anchor: There’s no window I can look out of and no clock.

facts.fact: 与妹妹 Jess 的聊天记录永远停在三个点，她这边也发不出消息。
facts.anchor: Whatever Jess had been typing is permanently frozen as three little dots in our chat.

facts.fact: 书架上有《The Reaper Handbook (Unabridged 150th Edition)》《The Wit and Wisdom of the Mids》《All I Need to Know I Learned in the Break Room: A Collection of Essays》三本书。
Handbook 前言说，没有情感正是把 Reaper（Us）与「他们」（Them）区分开的东西。
facts.anchor: Lack of emotions is what separates Us from Them.

facts.fact: 她擅自离开等待室后，Daniel 质问她为什么不听话。
facts.anchor: “Why didn’t you wait like I told you to?”

facts.fact: Daniel 告知她寿命延长八周，之后仍会再死并回到他身边。
facts.anchor: They’re giving you eight more weeks. After that, you will die again, and will return here with me.

facts.fact: 得知只剩八周后，她的反应是把它当成要尽量用足的时间额度。
facts.anchor: If I only have eight weeks, I’ll just have to make the most of them.
